title: Mindbody Alternatives for Yoga & Dance Studios (2026)
description: Mindbody alternatives with published prices: WellnessLiving, Arketa, Walla, Vagaro and Mariana Tek for yoga, pilates, dance and fitness studios.
h1: Mindbody alternatives for yoga, dance and fitness studios
body:
Mindbody says its plans start at $79/mo per location (North America and Asia) for Starter, with unlimited users. Accelerate and Ultimate prices are not published; Mindbody asks you to talk to sales (Mindbody pricing). If a client finds you through the Mindbody app and is new to your studio, Mindbody charges 20% (capped at $30) on that first purchase. If you are weighing other options for a yoga, pilates, dance or fitness studio, here is what the main alternatives publish.

We checked each vendor's own pricing page on October 31, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:mindbody,wellnessliving,arketa,walla,vagaro,mariana-tek}}

The alternatives

  • WellnessLiving: Starter $69/mo for one staff member, Business $199/mo with unlimited staff, BusinessPro $349/mo with a white-label client app (annual billing: $62, $179 and $314/mo). Free data migration and onboarding. Card processing rates are not on the pricing page.
  • Arketa: Individual $49/mo billed annually for one login, with a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30. Studio Core, Growth and Suite (unlimited team members) are quote only. Unlimited on-demand video storage on every plan; month to month unless you pick annual.
  • Walla: from $299/mo per location billed monthly, unlimited users, Book-a-Spot and on-demand video included. Walla says it adds no booking fees of its own; its optional Walla Offset passes a 3.9% fee to clients at checkout. Pro (branded app, two-way texting) is quote only.
  • Vagaro: $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99/mo for the first 6 months), plus $10/mo per extra calendar up to seven, then more staff at no extra cost. 30-day free trial and no cancellation fees.
  • Mariana Tek: no published prices (intro call required). Branded iOS and Android apps on every plan and pick-a-spot floor plans for reformers and bikes; Stripe processing with no Mariana Tek markup.
  • Zen Planner: from $99/mo (Studio) and aimed more at membership gyms and martial arts schools. See Zen Planner vs Mindbody.

Cost at a glance

Using only published prices: a one-person studio pays $30/mo on Vagaro (one calendar), $49/mo on Arketa Individual (billed annually, plus 3% per transaction), $69/mo on WellnessLiving Starter or from $79/mo on Mindbody Starter. With five instructors who each need a login or calendar, Vagaro is $70/mo (one calendar plus four at $10), WellnessLiving needs Business at $199/mo, Mindbody Starter stays from $79/mo per location, and Walla is $299/mo per location. Arketa Studio and Mariana Tek need a quote. Card processing is extra on all of them, and only Arketa publishes its rate.

Before you switch from Mindbody

Mindbody says your contract depends on your plan, billing terms and any promotion, and cancelling may need advance notice, so check your agreement first. Ask the new vendor whether they move client records, memberships and stored cards: WellnessLiving lists free data migration, Walla says Signature or Premier onboarding can move cards to Stripe, and Vagaro says a transfer typically takes 1-2 business days. Our software buying checklist covers the rest, and the membership revenue calculator helps you check what a fee change costs you.

Which to pick

For the lowest published monthly price with a small team, Vagaro. For published prices with unlimited staff, WellnessLiving Business. For a solo teacher selling classes and on-demand video, Arketa Individual. For a boutique studio that wants its own branded app instead of a marketplace, Mariana Tek or Walla Pro (both quote only). {{aff:wellnessliving|Visit WellnessLiving}} {{aff:marianatek|Visit Mariana Tek}}

faq: Mindbody publishes only its entry price: from $79/mo per location for Starter (North America and Asia), with unlimited users. Accelerate and Ultimate prices come from sales (mindbodyonline.com/business/pricing, checked 2026-10-31).

On published prices, Vagaro starts at $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99 for the first 6 months), Arketa Individual is $49/mo billed annually plus a 3% transaction fee, and WellnessLiving Starter is $69/mo for one staff member (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-10-31).
Does Mindbody charge a fee for app bookings?

Yes. Mindbody says listing on its app is free, but when the app brings a client who is new to your business, it charges 20% (capped at $30) on that first purchase. Later bookings carry no commission (Mindbody pricing FAQ).
Do I have to use Mindbody Payments?
No. Mindbody says you can use a third-party processor. Mindbody Payments charges a rate plus $0.10-$0.30 per transaction in North America and Asia (Mindbody pricing FAQ).
Which Mindbody alternatives include unlimited staff?

WellnessLiving Business ($199/mo) and BusinessPro, Arketa Studio plans (quote only), Walla (from $299/mo per location) and Mariana Tek (quote only). Vagaro adds $10/mo per bookable calendar up to seven, then more staff at no extra cost (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-10-31).
